summary: iter482 P3.1 backend validation. Full iter482 pytest suite = 196/196 PASS (zero regressions). New API-level smoke suite (test_iter482_p31_api_smoke.py, 40 tests) validates cent-exact reconciliation on Path A (/api/fees/v2/preview) + L-1 payment_processing gating across 13 scenarios × 3 dimensions (L-1 gate, buyer math, seller math). Historical $7 hammer / premium+premium case confirmed at exactly $7.28 (728 cents) — never $7.64/$7.31/$7.29. Cross-endpoint API-level test of Path B (/api/payments/checkout/preview/{listing_id}) not driven because it requires the caller to be the auction winner (only accepts listings where current user won); the equivalent calculator-level Path A==Path B reconciliation is fully verified by the 38-test test_iter482_p31_reconciliation.py suite (all pass).
critical_code_review_comments: P3.1 fix in stripe_connect_service.calculate_general_checkout correctly moves seller-commission tax out of buyer_total and into seller_payout deduction (Place-of-Supply §142.1). Verified by 40 API smoke assertions + 38 internal reconciliation tests.

Per-line CRA rounding (gst/qst rounded per component before summation) is now consistent between fee_calculator._iter350_individual and calculate_general_checkout — this is the source of the previous $0.02 divergence.
L-1 gate: payment_processing.amount_cents === 0 across all 13 sampled scenarios and legal_gate_status='REQUIRES_TAX_LEGAL_REVIEW'; frontend safe to hide Processing row.

Note: /api/payments/checkout/preview/{listing_id} requires the authenticated user to be the listing's winner. There is no direct hammer_price override path — this endpoint cannot be smoke-tested cross-scenario without seeding a completed auction. The 38-test P3.1 reconciliation suite is the authoritative Path A vs Path B check.

rca of the issue: Prior $0.02 divergence between Path A (calculate_fee) and Path B (calculate_general_checkout): Path B was computing GST+QST on a pooled (BP+SC) tax base with combined-rate rounding, effectively (a) charging the buyer for the seller's business-input tax on commission and (b) losing 1 cent to combined-rate rounding vs per-component CRA remittance rounding. Fix: split fees_tax into bp_tax_total (buyer bears, on their BP only) and sc_tax_total (deducted from seller_payout, on seller's SC only), and use per-line GST/QST rounding matching Revenu Québec remittance practice. Verified: 196/196 unit tests + 40/40 live API tests.
